• Comunicação: Capacidade de traduzir termos técnicos para o negócio, além de empatia para trabalhar entre equipes.

• Formação: Graduação em TI, cursos de tecnologia ou certificações em Cloud/DevOps.

Experiência no setor de mobilidade urbana, meios de pagamento, bilhetagem ou sistemas transacionais de alta escala.

Vivência com práticas de SRE (Site Reliability Engineer).

Experiência com pipelines mais robustos, estratégias de implantação e governança de ambientes.

Boa comunicação, senso de dono, autonomia e capacidade de apoio técnico a outros profissionais.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack — Inteligência Artificial (Pleno/Sênior)

  • recuperação, orquestração de prompts e contextualização de respostas.

  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Forte experiência com NestJS e arquitetura modular.
  • Experiência sólida em APIs REST e/ou GraphQL .

  • Experiência comprovável com RAG : embeddings/vetorização, conexão a bases documentais e orquestração de prompts.
  • Conhecimentos sobre o comportamento de LLMs e noções de machine learning .
  • Proficiência em JavaScript/TypeScript , além de HTML e CSS .
  • Experiência com bases de dados relacionais e/ou NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis).
  • Integrações via Webhooks , OAuth2 , JWT e APIs corporativas .
  • Conhecimentos de segurança e performance aplicados ao desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com cloud computing (AWS , Azure ou GCP ) para deploy e escalabilidade.
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


Diferenciais


  • Conhecimentos em DevOps e práticas de CI/CD .
  • Experiência com Docker , Kubernetes e automação de deploys.
  • Familiaridade com MLOps ou pipelines de dados.
  • Segurança da Informação aplicada a soluções com LLMs .
  • Testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e ).
  • Experiência com fine‑tuning ou otimização de modelos de IA.

O que oferecemos


✅ Modelo de contratação preferencialmente cooperado , com enquadramento competitivo.

✅ Posição de longo prazo , integrada em iniciativas estratégicas de IA e inovação.

✅ Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural, com interação constante com equipes globais.

✅ Flexibilidade de trabalho .

title: Desenvolvedor full stack Java e Angular Jr
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Desenvolver funcionalidades frontend usando Angular;
  • Implementar APIs RESTful com Java e Spring Boot;
  • Criar camadas de persistência de dados e rotinas de processamento em lote.
  • Linguagens de programação: Java, JavaScript, TypeScript;
  • Frameworks e bibliotecas: Springboot, Spring-Data-JPA, Hibernate, Spring Batch, Angular, AngularJS, Spring-web-mvc, Phonegap, Java EE;
  • Bancos de dados: Postgres, MongoDB, Oracle


Vaga Híbrida, 3x em São Paulo - Santo Amaro


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
Who we are

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and we’re on a bold mission: to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery around the world. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.”

With innovation and technology at our core, Keeta is expanding rapidly — with over 1,000 employees worldwide — and you can be part of this global journey.


About the position

We are looking for a HRBP to join our HR team in Brazil .

You will collaborate with a lean, high-impact team responsible for different business lines and strategic projects.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone comfortable operating in high-growth, 0→1 environments , balancing strategy, execution, and stakeholder management.


Job Responsibilities:

Organizational Optimization:

  • Assist business leaders in building an efficient organizational structure for Keeta, facilitating alignment of goals within the management team.
  • Regularly conduct organizational diagnostics to identify key issues and challenges, and proactively follow up on solutions.

Talent Development:

  • Utilize talent review, development, and co-creation facilitation methods to focus on the recruitment, training, development, and advancement of key talents.
  • Provide strong talent pipeline support and help build talent succession plans for business departments.

Culture Implementation:

  • Drive the implementation and promotion of corporate culture and values within the department.
  • Regularly organize employee engagement and care activities to communicate company philosophy and values, strengthening team cohesion and morale.

Strategic Partnership:

  • Gain deep understanding of the business strategy of the international team.
  • Participate in the entire process from strategy formulation to execution, and develop tailored HR plans to achieve both short- and long-term business objectives.


Job Requirements:

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above, HRBP experience; experience supporting international teams is preferred.
  2. Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate efficiently with international teams and partners.
  3. Strong logical thinking and learning ability, solid HR fundamentals, self-driven, curious, and able to work under pressure.


Job Highlights:

  1. Opportunity to participate in the building of an international team, broaden your horizons, and work with global talent.
  2. Fast-growing business with great personal development potential; work alongside a professional and high-caliber HR team.


Nice to have

  • Experience working in Chinese companies or multicultural, Asia-influenced environments.


Interested in joining Keeta?

Check out our open positions! When applying, your information will be securely stored and may be shared with Keeta and its global affiliates.

Apoiar auditorias internas e externas e monitorar atualizações da legislação tributária aplicável.

title: Vendedor

Sobre a AutoZone

A AutoZone é uma empresa americana e multinacional, listada na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York, reconhecida como a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo. Atualmente, possui mais de 7.000 lojas distribuídas pelos Estados Unidos, Porto Rico, México e Brasil, com o apoio de mais de 100.000 AutoZoners em quatro continentes.

No Brasil, a companhia mantém um ritmo acelerado de crescimento, com mais de 156 lojas em sete estados — São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás — além de um escritório corporativo em São Paulo, localizado na Vila Leopoldina. Em 2025, foi inaugurado o Centro de Distribuição próprio em Paulínia/SP, fortalecendo a estrutura logística e sustentando a estratégia de expansão no país.

A AutoZone tem como princípios a mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e o compromisso de ir além. Fazer parte da empresa significa integrar uma equipe que valoriza dedicação, trabalho em equipe e desenvolvimento profissional, oferecendo suporte e ferramentas para o crescimento e construção de carreira dos AutoZoners

Atua de forma proativa na prospecção e manutenção da carteira de clientes, realizando vendas ativas e acompanhando oportunidades. Também é responsável pelo gerenciamento do caixa comercial, garantindo o controle e a segurança dos valores movimentados.


Descrição da vaga:


  • Realizar atendimentos comerciais via WhatsApp e telefone, prestando suporte ao cliente durante todo o processo de venda;
  • Efetuar o fechamento de vendas com foco em conversão e satisfação do cliente;
  • Realizar vendas ativas, entrando em contato com clientes da carteira e da base RAC (Recuperação de Ativos de Clientes), promovendo produtos e serviços;
  • Manter relacionamento contínuo com os clientes, identificando oportunidades de recompra e fidelização;
  • Gerenciar o caixa da unidade, incluindo abertura, fechamento e controle de valores recebidos;
  • Garantir a correta movimentação financeira, zelando pela segurança e integridade dos recursos;
  • Registrar informações de vendas e atendimentos em sistemas internos, assegurando a atualização e organização dos dados;
  • Colaborar com a equipe comercial para o alcance de metas e indicadores de desempenho



Qualificações:


  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Pacote Office – básico;
  • Experiência em vendas e gestão de carteira de clientes;
  • Conhecimento em mecânica automotiva (diferencial);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala 6x1 de segunda a sábado.



Informações Adicionais


  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Benefícios oferecidos: assistência médica, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio com academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e 20% de desconto em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.

Venha crescer com a AutoZone e impulsionar o futuro da sua carreira!

EU Global Gateway Coordination Expert


NTU International is expanding its international network of senior experts to support current and upcoming assignments linked to the European Union’s Global Gateway Initiative across partner countries receiving EU external cooperation support.

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with demonstrated experience in coordinating and supporting investment-oriented development initiatives aligned with EU Global Gatewa y priorities. The objective is to strengthen local and regional expert networks and increase awareness, coordination capacity, and project preparation support for Global Gateway-related investments and reforms.

Experts may be engaged for short- and long-term assignments under EU-funded technical assistance projects, Team Europe initiatives, and donor-financed infrastructure and investment programmes.


Areas of Expertise

We are particularly interested in experts with experience in one or more of the following sectors:

  • Sustainable infrastructure
  • Energy and renewable energy
  • Digital transformation and connectivity
  • Transport infrastructure and mobility
  • Water, sanitation, and environmental management
  • Private sector development and investment promotion
  • Climate resilience and green transition
  • Public sector reforms linked to investment and infrastructure development


Key Responsibilities

Selected experts may support activities such as:

  • Contributing to the development and implementation of reform strategies and policy actions
  • Supporting coordination across EU Global Gateway priority sectors and stakeholders
  • Assisting in the identification and preparation of investment projects aligned with Global Gateway priorities
  • Conducting or contributing to regulatory , institutional , and sector analyses
  • Supporting feasibility preparation and investment pipeline development
  • Facilitating coordination between partner-country institutions, IFIs, Team Europe actors, private sector stakeholders, and development partners
  • Supporting stakeholder engagement, dialogue facilitation, and institutional coordination processes
  • Contributing to donor coordination and alignment with EU external cooperation priorities


Requirements

Candidates should demonstrate:

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in development cooperation , infrastructure , investment , or related sectors
  • Proven experience in EU-funded external cooperation programmes
  • Experience in project preparation and/or coordination under the EU Global Gateway framework, Team Europe initiatives, or similar investment-oriented international development programmes
  • Experience working with partner-country institutions , international financial institutions (IFIs) , development finance institutions , or private sector stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, coordination, and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Excellent communication and reporting abilities


Language Requirements

  • English proficiency at minimum C1 level is mandatory
  • Additional languages relevant to partner countries are considered an asset


Please note that inclusion in the expert pool does not guarantee immediate assignment. Experts will be contacted based on project requirements and matching qualifications. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Livestream Operations Manager (Content & Quality)
description:
Work Type: Remote

Salary: Starting from USD 500/month, with strong performance-based increases from Month 3 onwards

Language Requirement: English C2, Portuguese C2, Spanish C2


About City Explorer

City Explorer is a global livestreaming platform connecting people and cultures through real-life, immersive content. Our Explorers livestream cities, nature, culture, and daily life worldwide, supported by professional tools, structured training, and hands-on coaching.


As the platform and Academy continue to grow, maintaining consistent livestream quality is critical. We are now expanding our coaching leadership team.


The Role: Coach Manager (Livestreaming Quality Lead)

We are looking for a Coach Manager who will oversee our team of livestreaming coaches and take primary responsibility for maintaining high standards across the platform.


This role combines leadership, coaching supervision, quality control, and operational oversight. You will ensure livestreams meet both technical and content standards while helping coaches support Explorers effectively.


Livestreaming runs around the clock, so this role requires strong ownership, resilience, and initiative. You should be comfortable maintaining quality standards through team coordination, structured supervision, and proactive monitoring even outside standard working hours when needed.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate the livestream coaching team
  • Maintain overall livestream quality across the platform
  • Monitor both technical execution and content standards
  • Guide coaches on feedback quality, coaching structure, and consistency
  • Identify quality issues early and implement improvements
  • Support onboarding, training workflows, and coaching processes
  • Ensure Explorers maintain confidence, structure, and audience engagement during streams


Requirements

  • Language: English C2, Portuguese C2, Spanish C2
  • Strong personality with high accountability and ownership mindset
  • Proven experience in livestreaming, video content, media production, or coaching
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills
  • Strong work ethic and ability to operate in a fast-moving environment
  • Solid understanding of livestream technical setup and content presentation
  • Ability to coordinate teams and maintain standards consistently


Nice to Have

  • Previous team leadership or managerial experience
  • Background in media, broadcasting, or digital content production
  • Experience in training or mentoring creators
  • Familiarity with IRL livestreaming workflows


What We Offer

  • Direct impact on the quality and growth of a global livestreaming platform
  • Leadership role within an expanding international team
  • Clear salary progression based on performance
  • Hands-on involvement in both platform operations and training
  • Long-term growth opportunities as City Explorer scales


How to Apply

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

If you believe you are a strong fit and ready to take ownership of livestream quality at scale, please apply with a short introduction outlining your experience, leadership background, and availability.

title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
description:
About Nordian


Nordian is a U.S.-based company and a leader in high-precision positioning technology, delivering innovative solutions for industries such as Agriculture, Mining, Robotics, Drones, Automotive, and Mobile Applications. By integrating advanced sensors with state-of-the-art software, we help our customers optimize operations, increase efficiency, and drive innovation across their businesses. Joining our team means gaining hands-on experience in a cutting-edge technology sector with global impact.


This role is for someone who…


  • Is organized and attentive to technical details;
  • Enjoys learning through hands-on experience and taking responsibility;
  • Demonstrates autonomy, proactivity, and thrives in a dynamic and collaborative environment;
  • Seeks real-world experience in applied engineering and product development;
  • Values balancing academic learning with professional growth.


Responsibilities:


  • Prepare and update product technical documentation;
  • Create technical views and drawings of components and subassemblies (e.g., wiring harnesses);
  • Support 3D modeling and assembly of parts and mechanical systems;
  • Assist with product testing and validation activities, including sealing and water ingress tests;
  • Organize engineering documentation and revision records;
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives within product development processes;
  • Assist the technical team with product assembly and validation activities.


Requirements:


  • Currently enrolled in a Mechanical Engineering program or related field;
  • Preferably in the 7th semester or beyond (or equivalent stage);
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings;
  • Basic technical English for documentation reading;
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proactivity;
  • Availability to work 30 hours per week, aligned with academic schedule;
  • Availability to remain in the internship for approximately one year, with the possibility of full-time employment afterward.


Nice to Have:


  • Participation in student organizations or Junior Enterprises;
  • Academic or practical experience with 3D CAD modeling;
  • Knowledge of mechanical assembly processes;
  • Basic understanding of product testing and validation;
  • Interest in hardware development and electromechanical integration.


Why join Nordian?


At Nordian, you will be part of a dynamic and innovative team working with technologies that generate global impact. We value continuous learning and understand that an internship is primarily a development opportunity. Therefore, we encourage flexible working hours to support academic priorities while providing hands-on experience in real engineering projects, with the possibility of full-time employment upon completion of the program.

title: Gerente de Tecnologia da Informação
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Tecnologia da Informação.


Propósito do cargo

Garantir a eficiência, estabilidade e evolução do ambiente tecnológico da companhia, assegurando que os sistemas, infraestrutura e soluções digitais estejam alinhados à estratégia do negócio.

Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas, liderando projetos de tecnologia, promovendo integração de sistemas, governança de dados e transformação digital, contribuindo diretamente para a produtividade, escalabilidade e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.


Desafios

Integrar sistemas e processos em um ambiente regional com diferentes níveis de maturidade tecnológica.

  • Garantir a estabilidade e performance de sistemas críticos, especialmente o ERP TOTVS.
  • Liderar projetos de tecnologia com múltiplas interfaces e stakeholders.
  • Equilibrar demandas operacionais (suporte e infraestrutura) com iniciativas estratégicas (transformação digital).
  • Assegurar segurança da informação e governança de dados em toda a operação.
  • Reduzir dependência operacional por meio de automação e padronização de processos.

Desenvolver uma cultura de tecnologia orientada ao negócio e geração de valor.

  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros com foco em eficiência e qualidade de entrega.


Responsabilidades

Gestão de Sistemas e ERP (TOTVS)

  • Gerenciar o ambiente TOTVS, incluindo parametrização, sustentação, melhorias e suporte funcional.
  • Garantir a integração do ERP com demais sistemas (financeiro, comercial, supply chain, BI).
  • Acompanhar customizações e evoluções do sistema, assegurando aderência ao negócio.

Gestão de Projetos de Tecnologia

  • Liderar projetos de TI (implantação de sistemas, melhorias, automação e integrações).
  • Definir escopo, cronograma, orçamento, riscos e governança dos projetos.
  • Garantir entregas dentro do prazo, custo e qualidade esperados.

Infraestrutura e Suporte

  • Garantir disponibilidade, performance e segurança da infraestrutura de TI (redes, servidores, cloud e dispositivos).
  • Estruturar e acompanhar processos de suporte técnico com definição de SLAs e indicadores.
  • Promover melhoria contínua no atendimento aos usuários.

Segurança da Informação e Governança

  • Implementar políticas e práticas de segurança da informação.
  • Garantir proteção de dados, backups, controle de acessos e conformidade com normas.
  • Atuar em auditorias internas e externas.

Integração de Sistemas, Dados e BI

  • Apoiar a integração entre sistemas corporativos, garantindo consistência e confiabilidade dos dados.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas de BI para estruturação de relatórios e dashboards.
  • Promover governança de dados e qualidade da informação.

Gestão de Fornecedores

  • Gerenciar contratos e relacionamento com fornecedores de tecnologia.
  • Avaliar desempenho, custos e qualidade dos serviços prestados.

Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipe

  • Gerenciar a equipe de TI, promovendo desenvolvimento técnico e comportamental.
  • Estabelecer metas, indicadores e acompanhamento de performance.
  • Identificar necessidades de treinamento e capacitação (LNT).

Transformação Digital e Inovação

  • Identificar oportunidades de automação, digitalização e melhoria de processos.
  • Propor e implementar soluções tecnológicas alinhadas à estratégia da empresa.

Responsabilidades Adicionais

  • Liderar iniciativas de transformação digital e integração tecnológica na América do Sul.
  • Garantir a padronização de processos e documentação de TI.
  • Apoiar o planejamento estratégico com visão tecnológica.
  • Atuar como referência técnica interna para as áreas de negócio.
  • Realizar benchmarking de soluções tecnológicas e tendências de mercado.
  • Apoiar auditorias, compliance e governança corporativa.


Requisitos e qualificações


Requisitos de Qualificação

  • Formação Mínima Obrigatória

Formação Desejável

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de TI, Gestão de Projetos, Transformação Digital ou áreas afins.


Experiência

  • Experiência em implantação, sustentação e melhoria de ERP, incluindo parametrizações, integrações e customizações.

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • ADVPL / Linguagem TOTVS: Conhecimento em ADVPL para leitura, análise e acompanhamento de customizações, apoiando validação técnica, testes e interface com desenvolvedores.

title: Analista de Relacionamento Institucional Sênior
description:

Possuímos operações em 25 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Somos uma empresa privada, que está presente em milhares de lares desde os anos 50. Além disso, fazemos parte do seleto grupo de investidas ItauSA.

Acreditamos que a diversidade é fundamental para o nosso crescimento e da nossa sociedade como um todo. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são abertas para todas as pessoas, independente da origem, gênero, cor, orientação sexual, crenças.


Esta oportunidade também é destinada a pessoas com deficiência (PCD), alinhada ao nosso compromisso com a inclusão e a diversidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer – IoT Module


Founding software engineer for Quectel's new Manaus operation


Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil

Role Software Engineer – IoT Module – LATAM

Level Mid-Level (3–5 years of experience)

Type Full-Time, On-Site

Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus


About Quectel

Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular IoT modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud.


A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus

This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now.

Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America.


Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here.


Learn more about Quectel:

  • Company website — quectel.com
  • Our history & global footprint — quectel.com/company/history
  • LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric LatAm customer story (Brazil)
  • Follow us on LinkedIn


The Role

We're hiring one of the founding software engineers for Quectel's brand-new Manaus setup. You'll work on the embedded Linux software stacks running inside Quectel's cellular IoT modules — Qualcomm-based platforms supporting LTE, 5G, and LPWA technologies — and you'll be the go-to software expert for customers across Latin America.

Because the team is being built from scratch, you'll have unusual influence: the tooling, the development workflows, the customer-engagement model, the way we triage and resolve field issues — these are decisions you'll help make, not inherit. You'll collaborate closely with Quectel's global R&D centers while owning the LATAM software story end to end.


"You get the depth of an embedded Linux job — kernel, drivers, Yocto — and the rare chance to help build a brand-new operation from day one. That combination doesn't come around often."


What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain software modules for Quectel cellular modems (LTE / 5G / LPWA) on Qualcomm SoCs.
  • Build and tune Linux-based networking systems for IoT devices and gateways — TCP/IP, sockets, routing, the works.
  • Develop device drivers, daemons, and system services on embedded Linux.
  • Hunt down issues across the full stack — kernel, Yocto build system, middleware, and applications.
  • Use Wireshark, tcpdump, and your debugging instincts to crack tough field and lab problems.
  • Support LATAM customers directly: develop new SW features, debug their issues, maintain the SW stack, and improve our demo applications.
  • Partner with hardware, integration, and QA teams during board bring-up and validation.
  • Contribute to architecture decisions and performance optimization for the next generation of modules.


What You Bring

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience with embedded Linux, cellular modem development, or both.
  • Hands-on experience with Qualcomm-based modem SoCs and their firmware.
  • Strong C and C++ skills, with a real understanding of microcontroller/microprocessor architecture.
  • Solid knowledge of Linux internals and system programming.
  • Comfort with the Linux network stack and packet analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump).
  • Working knowledge of Linux networking: TCP/IP, sockets, routing.
  • Day-to-day experience with Git and Agile workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the communication chops to work directly with customers.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus.


Bonus Points For

  • Yocto Project or other embedded Linux build framework experience.
  • RTOS exposure.
  • LPWA experience (NB-IoT, LTE-M) and familiarity with cellular certification.
  • Prior FAE or customer-engineering experience in the LATAM region.


The Tech You'll Work With

  • Quectel's cellular module portfolio — 5G, LTE-A, LTE Cat 1/4, NB-IoT, and LTE-M, all on Qualcomm SoCs.
  • LATAM in production — see the Furukawa Electric LatAm case study for an example of the kind of work you'll support.
  • Quectel blog & insights — deep dives on cellular IoT, edge compute, and industry trends.


Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it.
  • Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM.
  • Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed IoT company behind you.
  • Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem.
  • Cutting-edge technology — 5G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices.
  • Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales.
  • Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products.
  • Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks.
  • Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent).
  • Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance).
  • Health insurance with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Paid time off.
  • International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows.


Ready to Apply?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis.


Apply via: | Browse open roles: quectel.com/recruitment


Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

title: Global Therapist: Integrated Critical Incident Response (ICIR)
description:
Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health. At Spring Health, we’re on a mission to revolutionize mental healthcare by removing every barrier that prevents people from getting the help they need, when they need it. Our clinically validated technology, Precision Mental Healthcare, empowers us to deliver the right care at the right time—whether it’s therapy, coaching, medication, or beyond—tailored to each individual’s needs. We proudly partner with over 450 companies, from startups to multinational Fortune 500 corporations, as a leading provider of mental health service, providing care for 10 million people. Our clients include brands you use and know like Microsoft, Target, and Delta Airlines, all of whom trust us to deliver best-in-class outcomes for their employees globally. With our innovative platform, we’ve been able to generate a net positive ROI for employers and we are the only company in our category to earn external validation of net savings for customers. We have raised capital from prominent investors including Generation Investment, Kinnevik, Tiger Global, William K Warren Foundation, Northzone, RRE Ventures, and many more. Thanks to their partnership and our latest Series E Funding, our current valuation has reached $3.3 billion. We’re just getting started—join us on our journey to make mental healthcare accessible to everyone, everywhere.


What You'll Do:

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.
  • Integrated Critical Incident Response (ICIR) is a specialized service you can offer through Spring Health. It involves providing timely support to employees at organizations that are navigating workplace-related crises at both the macro level (natural disasters, civil unrest, etc.) and micro level (workforce reductions, death of a co-worker, etc.).
  • Employers might request your support for in-person or virtual group sessions, or 1:1 check-ins. This can include:
  • Group Support: Typically a 1-hour debriefing session with additional resources and follow-up care available through Spring Health.
  • 1:1 Support: 15-minute check-ins with the goal of normalizing the employee’s experience and connecting them to Spring Health for follow-up care if it's appropriate.

Who You Are:

  • You have an unrestricted license to practice counseling (Psychologist, Masters level counselor, etc.) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring licensed supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure)
  • Minimum 3 years of total experience within mental health.
  • Have a dedicated office space in which to provide in-person therapy if you choose to provide those services.
  • You're comfortable with technology and are tele-health competent.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.
  • Previous experience delivering CIR services is preferred
  • You must be willing to travel up to one hour from your home to customer locations for delivery of in-person CIR services

Benefits of working with Spring Health:

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!


Not sure if you meet every requirement? Research shows that women and people from historically underrepresented communities often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every qualification compared to other similarly-qualified candidates. At Spring Health, we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and supported to Thrive . If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.



Ready to do the most impactful work of your life? Learn more about our values, what it’s like to work here, and how hyper-growth meets impact at Spring Health: Our Values



Our privacy policy:



Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. description:
Pioneirismo que nos orgulha, responsabilidade que nos guia.


Muito além de uma divulgação de vaga, este é um convite para você fazer parte de uma história pioneira, que une inovação, responsabilidade socioambiental e relevância estratégica no cenário global da mineração de terras raras.

Somos a Mineração Serra Verde e operamos uma unidade integrada de mineração e processamento de terras raras em Minaçu-GO. Os elementos de terras raras (ETRs) de alto valor que a Serra Verde fornece, são essenciais para a produção de ímãs permanentes usados nos setores de energia, transporte, aeroespacial e eletrônico.

Iniciamos a produção comercial na Fase I do nosso depósito Pela Ema, abrigando um dos maiores depósitos de argila iônica fora da Ásia, com vantagens competitivas e ambientais devido à natureza do depósito, com impactos ambientais relativamente baixos e situado em uma área de mineração consolidada, próxima à infraestrutura de energia renovável.

Na Serra Verde, nossos valores nos guiam todos os dias: Atuamos com integridade, confiança e transparência. Valorizamos a excelência. Criamos e compartilhamos valor sustentável. Somos otimistas e apaixonados. Assumimos a responsabilidade pessoal.

Valorizamos a diversidade de histórias, perspectivas e talentos, pois sabemos que é essa pluralidade que fortalece nossa cultura e nos impulsiona a alcançar resultados cada vez mais relevantes. Nesta perspectiva, todas as nossas vagas também estão abertas para PCD`s.


Como você poderá contribuir?


Responsável por assegurar a disponibilidade e desempenho da frota de veículos e equipamentos, respondendo pelas atividades planejamento, execução e controle dos serviços de manutenção da frota, assegurando condições adequadas de funcionamento, atualização tecnológica e conservação dos recursos, dentro dos custos projetados, acompanhando e orientando sua equipe.


Vivências você vai desenvolver para esta posição:


Vivência com atuação em equipamentos de Linha Amarela e Branca como escavadeiras, carregadeiras, motoniveladoras e caminhões de mineração (marcas como Caterpillar e Volvo)


Domínio em hidráulica de alta pressão, motores a diesel de grande porte e sistemas de transmissão.


Interpretação de cronogramas, gerenciar ordens de serviço e garantir o cumprimento do plano preventivo. Familiaridade com análise de óleo, termografia e análise de vibração


Responsável em bater metas de disponibilidade de frota


Liderança com time de mecânicos, eletricistas e soldadores


Conhecimento de NR-12 (Máquinas), NR-22 (Mineração) e NR-35 (Altura)


Habilidade para desenvolver a mão de obra técnica sob sua supervisão

Formação Completa de Técnico em Mecânica ou Eletromecânica

title: Business Process Improvement Manager
description:
Job Responsibilities

  1. Define and govern service policies across the takeaway ecosystem (customer, merchant, and rider), ensuring a balanced, sustainable three-sided experience aligned with regional business strategy.
  2. Architect the end-to-end service journey from AI-driven self-service through to human-assisted resolution—owning service routing logic, tiered escalation frameworks, and service risk-control mechanisms.
  3. Localize service design for the Brazilian market , translating customer behavioral insights into culturally appropriate service flows, resolution frameworks, and frontline communication playbooks.
  4. Drive frontline process excellence by designing clear, concise, and operationally efficient workflows for the customer service center—continuously optimizing to raise first-contact resolution rates and reduce handling time.
  5. Lead data-driven service improvement by analyzing service metrics, VOC (Voice of Customer), and operational data to identify systemic pain points, then partnering with product, operations, and technology teams to drive root-cause elimination and upstream business change.
  6. Influence cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Operations, Technology, Quality) to embed service-design thinking into business decisions, acting as the subject-matter expert on service experience within the takeaway vertical.

Job Requirements


  1. Deep domain expertise in the food-delivery/takeaway industry, with a thorough understanding of three-sided marketplace dynamics and associated service rules for customers, merchants, and riders.
  2. Proven track record in service process design and customer experience management , with demonstrated ability to architect full-journey service frameworks at scale.
  3. Strong analytical capability —able to independently structure ambiguous problems, derive insights from complex data sets, and translate findings into actionable improvement programs with measurable outcomes.
  4. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills , with the ability to influence without authority across functions and geographies.
  5. Customer-centric mindset with an instinct for balancing user experience against operational feasibility and business sustainability.
  6. Rigorous, execution-oriented work style with high ownership, resilience, and willingness to travel domestically within Brazil.
  7. Brazil market experience required ; fluency in both Portuguese and English as working languages.
  8. Relevant experience in BPI, service design, customer operations, or a related field; experience leading cross-regional or multi-site initiatives strongly preferred.

Role Highlights


  1. High-impact, high-complexity scope — manage intricate business operations and influence a large, multi-regional agent workforce across multiple locations in Brazil.
  2. Strategic business collaboration — deeply participate in formulating and optimizing business strategies with a direct line of sight to customer experience outcomes.
  3. Cross-cultural growth environment — work in a collaborative, international team with rich opportunities for cross-national learning, cultural exchange, and career development.

title: Country Manager
description:
About the Company


The Exafield Group is a fieldwork agency operating in the USA, Canada, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Switzerland, Poland, UK and LATAM. Our mission is to recruit, collect and analyze data from healthcare professionals and patients for market research purposes. We are the only fieldwork agency able to offer local presence in Europe, North America and LATAM under the same company and with the same standards. The Exafield Group is a dynamic organization made up of enthusiastic and committed team players who thrive in delivering high quality services in this fast-paced industry.


About the Role


The Country Manager for Brazil will be responsible for leading and developing Exafield’s operations and commercial growth in the Brazilian market, acting as the key representative of the company locally. This role combines business development, operational leadership, and team management, ensuring sustainable growth, high-quality project delivery, and strong client relationships. Working closely with the LATAM Managing Director and global teams, this person will own the Brazilian market, driving strategy, execution, and positioning Exafield as a trusted partner in healthcare market research.


Responsibilities


Team Management & Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing local team (Project Managers, recruiters, etc.)
  • Recruit, train, and mentor team members
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement
  • Ensure team alignment with global standards and local market needs
  • Work closely with LATAM, Europe, and North America teams
  • Contribute to global growth initiatives


Operational Leadership & Delivery Excellence

  • Oversee local operations to ensure high-quality project execution
  • Compliance with timelines and client expectations
  • Coordinate closely with the local team
  • Ensure smooth handover from sales to operations
  • Support feasibility, methodology adaptation, and local execution strategies


Commercial Development & Market Growth

  • Define and execute the commercial strategy for Brazil aligned with LATAM and global objectives
  • Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities with Market Research agencies
  • Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline and ensure conversion into revenue
  • Achieve and exceed revenue targets and KPIs
  • Lead RFQs, including feasibility assessment, pricing, and proposal development
  • Ensure strong follow-up and conversion of opportunities into confirmed projects
  • Act as the main point of contact for clients in Brazil
  • Build long-term, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders
  • Understand client needs and proactively propose tailored, high-value solutions
  • Position Exafield as a strategic partner rather than a supplier
  • Implement strong after-sales follow-up processes


Market Intelligence & Strategy

  • Provide insights on Brazilian healthcare and market research landscape
  • Support adaptation of methodologies to local realities
  • Contribute to pricing and positioning strategies
  • Act as a brand ambassador for Exafield in Brazil
  • Strengthen market presence through industry events and conferences, client visits and networking, LinkedIn and thought leadership initiatives
  • Drive local brand awareness and positioning

Location

Based in Brazil (Florianopolis/open to move/Hybrid)


Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in leading teams and Commercial roles as Business Developer
  • Proven experience managing clients and driving revenue growth
  • Experience in Market Research (preferred) or Healthcare / Pharma industry


Languages

  • Portuguese (native or fluent)
  • English (fluent – mandatory)
  • Spanish (highly preferred)

Skills & Competencies

  • Emotional intelligence and relationship-building skills
  • Strong commercial and strategic mindset (hunter + builder profile)
  • Leadership and team management capabilities
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • High level of organization, ownership, and accountability
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, multicultural environment
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a “make things happen” attitude
  • Strong problem-solving and solution-oriented thinking
  • Be solution-oriented
  • Collaborate and continuously improve
  • Stay flexible to ensure client success

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary + performance-based bonus
  • Opportunity to lead and shape Brazil as a strategic market
  • Exposure to global clients and international projects
  • Dynamic, entrepreneurial, and collaborative culture
  • Career growth opportunities within a global organization


Equal Opportunity Statement

We are committed to diversity and inclusivity in our hiring practices.

title: Human Resources Shared Services & Payroll Specialist
description:

This role ensures accurate and timely payroll processing, maintains HR data integrity, and provides high-quality support to employees and managers. The position partners with HR, Finance, and business stakeholders to ensure compliance, efficiency, and a positive employee experience.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Processes payroll for the United States employees, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance

title: Mechanical Supervisor
description:
Location: Dalian, China (initial phase) | Brazil Offshore (subsequent operations)

Rights to Work: Brazil

Employment Type: Contractor / Rotational


Role Description

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Supervisor to join a major offshore oil and gas project, initially based at a shipyard in Dalian, China during the construction and pre-commissioning phase, before mobilising to Brazil for offshore operations. The successful candidate will play a critical role in overseeing mechanical installation, inspection, and commissioning activities, ensuring compliance with project specifications, international standards, and client requirements.


Construction & Commissioning Phase (Dalian, China)

  • Supervise and coordinate all mechanical installation activities at the shipyard, including rotating equipment, static equipment, piping systems, and structural mechanical components
  • Review and interpret engineering drawings, P&IDs, isometrics, and equipment data sheets
  • Monitor contractor and vendor progress against project schedules, flagging deviations and driving corrective actions
  • Conduct daily site walks and formal inspections, ensuring work is executed in accordance with approved procedures and specifications
  • Attend and participate in FAT (Factory Acceptance Tests) and SAT (Site Acceptance Tests) for mechanical equipment
  • Interface with QA/QC teams to ensure all mechanical work packages are correctly documented, punch-listed, and closed out
  • Liaise with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to resolve technical queries and NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports) in a timely manner
  • Support Pre-Commissioning and Commissioning activities in preparation for sail-away


Offshore Operations Phase (Brazil)

  • Supervise mechanical maintenance and operational activities in accordance with the approved maintenance management system
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements (ANP, IBAMA) and applicable international standards (API, ASME, ISO)
  • Lead and coordinate mechanical shutdown and turnaround activities
  • Monitor equipment condition and performance, recommending preventive and corrective maintenance strategies
  • Support HSE initiatives and enforce permit-to-work systems (PTW) at all times



Requirements

  • Mechanical supervision experience in offshore or FPSO projects
  • Proven shipyard construction experience, ideally in Asia
  • Strong background in rotating and static equipment
  • Proficiency in engineering drawings, international codes (ASME, API, ABNT), and CMMS platforms
  • Degree or technical diploma in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent trade qualification)
  • Valid offshore survival certification (OPITO/HUET); NR-10, NR-33, NR-37 required or to be obtained
  • Fluency in Portuguese mandatory; working English essential

title: Analista financeiro
description:
Apresentação do Cargo:


Realizar análises financeiras, executando conciliações complexas, apoiando em fechamentos contábeis, elaborando relatórios financeiros e contribuindo para a gestão financeira eficiente através de análise de dados e execução precisa de processos.


Responsabilidades e Atividades:


  • Implantação e aprimoramento contínuo das políticas de cobrança e contas a receber, atuando em conjunto com a Gerência Financeira.
  • Criação, revisão e manutenção de rotinas operacionais, fluxos de trabalho e manuais de procedimentos, visando a padronização e melhoria dos processos financeiros.
  • Gerenciamento de contas a receber relacionadas a eventos, hospedagem e processos de tripulação, assegurando correta faturação e recebimento.
  • Acompanhamento, análise crítica e revisão do Aging List, com atuação ativa na cobrança de títulos vencidos e mitigação da inadimplência.
  • Realização de baixa de títulos, liquidação financeira e conciliações sistêmicas, garantindo a integridade das informações contábeis e financeiras.
  • Baixa de recebimentos em sistema e gestão ativa da cobrança de débitos em aberto, incluindo negociações com clientes inadimplentes.
  • Distribuição, organização, agrupamento e arquivamento físico e digital de faturas e documentos financeiros, conforme políticas internas e requisitos de auditoria.
  • Conciliação de retornos bancários, análise de pagamentos, emissão de extratos bancários e acompanhamento de divergências.
  • Atuação em negociações de cobrança, recuperação de crédito e regularização de débitos junto a clientes inadimplentes.
  • Acompanhamento diário dos recebimentos efetuados, análise do fluxo de caixa e elaboração de projeções de faturamento e recebimento.
  • Elaboração e controle diário do caixa, incluindo gestão de adiantamentos, saldos e aplicações de curto prazo, quando aplicável.
  • Geração e apresentação de relatórios gerenciais semanais de Aging de Clientes à Gerência Financeira, com análise de riscos e propostas de ação.
  • Controle e acompanhamento dos processos faturados (hospedagem, eventos e tripulação), garantindo prazos, valores e conformidade contratual.
  • Emissão, envio e controle de boletos, duplicatas e demais títulos de cobrança, assegurando o correto envio ao cliente.
  • Análise e tratamento de processos de contestação de vendas (chargebacks), atuando na prevenção de fraudes e recuperação de valores indevidamente contestados.
  • Atendimento e suporte a auditorias internas e externas, com apresentação clara dos processos, controles implantados e documentação comprobatória.
  • Atuação na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria, automação de processos e redução de riscos no ciclo de contas a receber.
  • Suporte à Gerência Financeira na análise de indicadores (KPIs), inadimplência, prazo médio de recebimento (PMR) e eficiência da cobrança.



Requisitos:


  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em finanças ou contabilidade
  • Experiência de 3 anos ou mais em análise financeira
  • Vivência em hotéis ou empresas de grande porte
  • Experiência com sistemas ERP complexos

title: Hardware Engineer
description:
Hardware Electronics Engineer


Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in Manaus


Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil

Role Hardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM

Level Mid-Level (1-3 years of experience)

Type Full-Time, On-Site

Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus


About Quectel

Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular IoT modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud.


A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus

This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now.

Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America.


Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here.


Learn more about Quectel:

  • Company website — quectel.com
  • Our history & global footprint — quectel.com/company/history
  • LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric LatAm customer story (Brazil)
  • Follow us on LinkedIn


The Role

We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial IoT, connected payments, and more.

Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R&D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market.


"Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay."


What You'll Do

  • Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions.
  • Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs.
  • Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues.
  • Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams.
  • Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities.
  • Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster.
  • Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM.
  • Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations.


What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles.
  • Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces.
  • Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis.
  • Comfortable with serial interfaces — I²C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug.
  • Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes.
  • Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS).
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus.


Bonus Points For

  • Experience designing PCBA end-to-end.
  • Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C.
  • Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO.
  • RF testing experience across cellular (2G/3G/4G/5G) and Wi-Fi 802.11.
  • Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration.
  • Prior ANATEL homologation experience.
  • Team leadership or technical mentoring experience.


The Tech You'll Work With

  • Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas.
  • Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies.
  • See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more.


Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it.
  • Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM.
  • Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed IoT company behind you.
  • Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem.
  • Cutting-edge technology — 5G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices.
  • Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales.
  • Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products.
  • Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks.
  • Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent).
  • Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance).
  • Health insurance with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Paid time off.
  • International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows.


Ready to Apply?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis.


Apply via: | Browse open roles: quectel.com/recruitment


Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

A AutoZone é uma empresa americana e multinacional, listada na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York, reconhecida como a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo. Atualmente, possui mais de 7.000 lojas distribuídas pelos Estados Unidos, Porto Rico, México e Brasil, com o apoio de mais de 100.000 AutoZoners em quatro continentes.

title: Global Therapist: Integrated Critical Incident Response (ICIR)
description:
Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health. At Spring Health, we’re on a mission to revolutionize mental healthcare by removing every barrier that prevents people from getting the help they need, when they need it. Our clinically validated technology, Precision Mental Healthcare, empowers us to deliver the right care at the right time—whether it’s therapy, coaching, medication, or beyond—tailored to each individual’s needs. We proudly partner with over 450 companies, from startups to multinational Fortune 500 corporations, as a leading provider of mental health service, providing care for 10 million people. Our clients include brands you use and know like Microsoft, Target, and Delta Airlines, all of whom trust us to deliver best-in-class outcomes for their employees globally. With our innovative platform, we’ve been able to generate a net positive ROI for employers and we are the only company in our category to earn external validation of net savings for customers. We have raised capital from prominent investors including Generation Investment, Kinnevik, Tiger Global, William K Warren Foundation, Northzone, RRE Ventures, and many more. Thanks to their partnership and our latest Series E Funding, our current valuation has reached $3.3 billion. We’re just getting started—join us on our journey to make mental healthcare accessible to everyone, everywhere.


What You'll Do:

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.
  • Integrated Critical Incident Response (ICIR) is a specialized service you can offer through Spring Health. It involves providing timely support to employees at organizations that are navigating workplace-related crises at both the macro level (natural disasters, civil unrest, etc.) and micro level (workforce reductions, death of a co-worker, etc.).
  • Employers might request your support for in-person or virtual group sessions, or 1:1 check-ins. This can include:
  • Group Support: Typically a 1-hour debriefing session with additional resources and follow-up care available through Spring Health.
  • 1:1 Support: 15-minute check-ins with the goal of normalizing the employee’s experience and connecting them to Spring Health for follow-up care if it's appropriate.

Who You Are:

  • You have an unrestricted license to practice counseling (Psychologist, Masters level counselor, etc.) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring licensed supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure)
  • Minimum 3 years of total experience within mental health.
  • Have a dedicated office space in which to provide in-person therapy if you choose to provide those services.
  • You're comfortable with technology and are tele-health competent.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.
  • Previous experience delivering CIR services is preferred
  • You must be willing to travel up to one hour from your home to customer locations for delivery of in-person CIR services


Benefits of working with Spring Health:

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!


Not sure if you meet every requirement? Research shows that women and people from historically underrepresented communities often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every qualification compared to other similarly-qualified candidates. At Spring Health, we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and supported to Thrive . If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.



Ready to do the most impactful work of your life? Learn more about our values, what it’s like to work here, and how hyper-growth meets impact at Spring Health: Our Values



Our privacy policy:



Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

  • You have an unrestricted license to practice counseling (Psychologist, Masters level counselor, etc.) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring licensed supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure)
  • Minimum 3 years of total experience within mental health.
  • Have a dedicated office space in which to provide in-person therapy if you choose to provide those services.
  • You're comfortable with technology and are tele-health competent.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.
  • Previous experience delivering CIR services is preferred
  • You must be willing to travel up to one hour from your home to customer locations for delivery of in-person CIR services


Benefits of working with Spring Health:

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!

description:

  • Automação de infraestrutura (IaC – Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK)
  • Pipelines de CI/CD
  • Monitoramento e observabilidade
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de segurança e compliance, assegurando aderência a boas práticas de IAM, KMS, redes e governança.
  • Identificar e implementar iniciativas de otimização de custos (FinOps) e gerenciamento de capacidade.
  • Avaliar ambientes existentes e sugerir roadmaps de modernização, migração e otimização, considerando custo, performance, segurança e governança.
  • Planejar e conduzir:
  • Workshops técnicos e executivos
  • Sessões de discovery e design
  • Apresentações técnicas e de arquitetura
  • Desenhar e executar labs, provas de conceito (PoCs) e demonstrações de soluções, serviços e novas tecnologias em cloud.


Atuação Consultiva e de Negócios

  • Apoiar a identificação de novas oportunidades de negócio, atuando junto aos times comerciais e de pré‑vendas.
  • Realizar diagnósticos técnicos e arquiteturais dos ambientes dos clientes, identificando gaps, riscos e oportunidades de evolução e expansão.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas, contribuindo para elaboração de propostas e apresentações executivas.
  • Atuar como interface técnica entre clientes, áreas comerciais, pré‑vendas, engenharia e parceiros/fabricantes.
  • Apoiar a ampliação de projetos existentes, propondo novas soluções, serviços e evoluções técnicas.
  • Participar de reuniões estratégicas com clientes, atuando como referência técnica confiável e consultor de longo prazo.


Gestão de Projetos e Times

  • Gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, qualidade, recursos e riscos.
  • Levantar necessidades e expectativas de clientes e stakeholders.
  • Definir objetivos claros, mensuráveis e alinhados ao negócio.
  • Definir, gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do time, garantindo entregas de valor.
  • Estruturar e operar o processo de gestão do fluxo de demandas, incluindo:Entrada, Detalhamento, Priorização, Acompanhamento
  • Comunicação com áreas envolvidas
  • Garantir a realização e efetividade das cerimônias ágeis (Scrum / Kanban).
  • Comunicar continuamente o andamento, riscos e resultados das iniciativas.
  • Gerenciar atividades e indicadores do time, assegurando entregas e acordos firmados com o cliente.


O que você precisa para ocupar esta vaga?

  • Formação superior completa
  • Certificação completa em AWS relevantes (como AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional e/ou specialty).
  • Experiência sólida trabalhando com arquitetura em AWS , e preferencialmente no setor financeiro.
  • Proficiência em serviços como EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, CloudFormation, CloudFront, entre outros.
  • Conhecimento em automação de infraestrutura usando Terraform, AWS CDK ou CloudFormation.
  • Sólido entendimento de redes, segurança em nuvem e práticas de compliance (IAM, KMS, etc.).
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e práticas DevOps.
  • Capacidade de analisar e otimizar ambientes em cloud com foco em FinOps.
  • Inglês intermediário (para conversação,leitura e escrita).

Perfil Esperado

  • Capacidade analítica e postura consultiva (trusted advisor).
  • Foco em geração de valor, evolução contínua e expansão de oportunidades.

title: Creator Acquisition  - Analista comercial | Hunting
description:
MISSÃO DO CARGO:


Construir e operar o motor de aquisição ativa de creators de alta performance da Privacy em LATAM (Brasil e Colômbia), atuando como ponta de lança na conversão de creators T3-T1 que ainda não estão na plataforma.

Responsável pela criação do pipeline outbound, abordagem consultiva e fechamento, alimentando a operação de Creator Success com creators qualificados para escala de TPV.

● Construir e operar pipeline ativo de aquisição de creators de alta performance em Brasil, com meta clara de conversão semanal, mensal e trimestral.

● Definir, em conjunto com CMO e área de CS, o ICP (Ideal Creator Profile) por tier-alvo.

● Realizar prospecção outbound multicanal (DM, e-mail, redes sociais: TikTok, Kwai, Instagram, YouTube, entre outros) com cadência estruturada e disciplinada.

● Negociar condições de entrada com creators de maior porte, em alinhamento com Marketing e CS.

● Gerenciar funil em CRM com disciplina absoluta: volume de abordagens, taxa de resposta, taxa de conversão, tempo médio de fechamento, motivos de perda.

● Reportar semanalmente performance ao CMO com leitura de pipeline, ajustes táticos e plano de

recuperação de gaps.

● Retroalimentar Marketing e Produto com inteligência de mercado: objeções recorrentes, percepção de marca, gaps de proposta de valor, perfis emergentes, movimentações de concorrência.

● Mapear e ativar comunidades, eventos e canais relevantes para aquisição de creators em LATAM.

● Apoiar a construção de materiais de abordagem e apresentação comercial em parceria com Branding e Marketing.


KPIs E METAS:


● Número de creators ativados por mês (Leads: Cadastro > utilização da plataforma — conteúdos).

● Taxa de conversão do funil em cada etapa: abordagem → reunião → contrato.

● TPV potencial estimado dos creators ativados (qualidade do funil, não só volume).

● SLA e qualidade do handoff entregue ao time de CS.

● Tempo médio de conversão (lead → ativação).

Formação Acadêmica

● Superior completo em qualquer área. Diferencial: Administração, Comunicação, Engenharia, Economia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas
